lines.text: He's dressed to impress for the interview.

data.define: Wearing fancy clothes to make a good impression.

example.text: He's dressed to impress for the interview.

misuse.text: Don't say 'dressed to impress' about pajamas.
misuse.why: It means a smart, planned outfit.

data.l1_hook: Hari wawancara. Aku 'dressed to impress' dengan setelan jas dan dasi!

native.tip: “dressed to impress” = berpakaian sangat rapi. Contoh: “He's dressed to impress for the interview.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “dressed to impress”?

Contoh: “He's dressed to impress for the interview.” (Dia "dressed to impress" untuk wawancara.)
